name: Home renders all four assessments and CTA navigates to Start
description: The homepage server-renders the hero and all four assessment cards in a grid, and the hero 'Take a test' call-to-action navigates the user to the Start page.

planSteps.description: Verify the hero headline reads 'See the arc you're on.' and four assessment cards are laid out in a two-by-two grid, each card showing one of these exact titles: 'The Solstice Cycle Assessment', 'The Modes of Mind Assessment', 'The Spectrum of Self Assessment', 'The Passage of Time Assessment'.
Click the 'Take a test' call-to-action button in the hero
Verify the page navigates to the Start page, which shows the heading 'Pick an assessment to start with.' and a list of four assessments.
